in_marathi.name: Sanu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon or Snow
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sanu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sanu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'San' which means 'Moon' and 'Nu' which means 'Snow'. It is believed that the name signifies the beauty of the moon and the serenity of snow. In Hindu mythology, Sanu is also the name of a demon king who is the younger brother of King Mahabali, and is known for his kindness and generosity.
